description: Install dependencies and verify baseline build/tests pass before making changes
steps: Run npx vite build to verify the project compiles cleanly
Run npx vitest run to verify existing tests pass
acceptance_criteria: vitest run shows all existing tests passing (or identify pre-existing failures)
findings: All verifications passed successfully. npm install completed (added 93 packages, 381 audited, 5 vulnerabilities - 3 moderate, 1 high, 1 critical - all pre-existing). Vite build compiled 335 modules in 2.22s. All 1094 tests pass across 77 test files (11.52s). Note: NODE_OPTIONS env var has a broken --require path (/opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js) that must be unset before running npm/vite/vitest commands. Pre-existing warnings: React act() warnings in several component tests (ProductRelationshipsPanel, TrimsPanel, MountingRules, etc.), Supabase env vars not set warning, and some Konva/react-konva DOM attribute warnings.
